exact: maintenance of centromeric meiotic sister chromatin cohesion
maintenance of meiotic sister chromatin cohesion at centromere
maintenance of sister chromatin cohesion at centromere at meiosis I

definition: The process in which the association between sister chromatids of a replicated chromosome along the length of the centromeric region is maintained as chromosomes condense, attach to the spindle in a bipolar orientation, and congress to the metaphase plate during a meiotic cell cycle.
label: maintenance of meiotic sister chromatid cohesion, centromeric
